title: Cash Purchases Added to Member-Filed Quantity Limit Renewal Requests
content:
Cash purchases are added to the quantity a member-filed renewal of a quantity limit authorization on an acute migraine drug asks for under the Utilization Management Program.

**Rule.** 2 or more paper claims for the drug denied because a coverage review was required, with the denial dated within the last 2 months, add 1 unit; exactly 1 such denial adds 0.5 unit; none adds nothing.

| Paper-claim denials for the drug, reason coverage review required, dated within the last 2 months | Added to the renewal request |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 1 unit |
| exactly 1 | 0.5 unit |
| none | nothing |

The paper claims are those the member submitted under the Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit. The 2 months end on the filing date: a denial counts when dated after the same day of the month two months before the filing date.

*Hypothetical case:* filing date 31 May; one qualifying denial on 15 May and one on 31 March. Two months before 31 May is 31 March; the 31 March denial is not after that day, so only one denial counts and 0.5 unit is added.
